notes: Captured from the archivist sandbox (~/owbn/_localwp-oat) after seed-help-shots.php: made-up people, chronicles and keys. OWBN Core's screens are English-only, so the Portuguese pages reuse these images with Portuguese alt text.

alt.en: OWBN Core Settings on the General tab: the API Gateway section with Enable Gateway, Gateway Base URL, a masked API Key with Generate, Auth Methods, Domain Whitelist and Request Logging.
alt.pt_BR: OWBN Core Settings na aba General: a seção API Gateway com Enable Gateway, Gateway Base URL, uma API Key mascarada com Generate, Auth Methods, Domain Whitelist e Request Logging.

alt.en: The Chronicles tab: Data Source with Local and Remote, the Remote URL and API Key overrides, the list and detail pages, Status and Search Data.
alt.pt_BR: A aba Chronicles: Data Source com Local e Remote, as substituições de Remote URL e API Key, as páginas de lista e de detalhe, Status e Search Data.

alt.en: The OAT tab: Data Source with Local and Remote, the Remote URL and API Key overrides, and Status.
alt.pt_BR: A aba OAT: Data Source com Local e Remote, as substituições de Remote URL e API Key, e Status.

alt.en: The Player ID tab: Mode with Server and Client, the SSO Server URL, and Status.
alt.pt_BR: A aba Player ID: Mode com Server e Client, a SSO Server URL e Status.

alt.en: The accessSchema tab: Mode with Local and Remote, Server URL, a masked API Key, Role Cache TTL, Status with the roles cache and Registered Clients, and Search Data.
alt.pt_BR: A aba accessSchema: Mode com Local e Remote, Server URL, uma API Key mascarada, Role Cache TTL, Status com o cache de cargos e Registered Clients, e Search Data.

alt.en: The OWBN Menu tab: the admin bar links, each with a Title, a URL and a remove button, then + Add Link, Save Links and a Preview.
alt.pt_BR: A aba OWBN Menu: os links da barra de administração, cada um com Title, URL e um botão de remover, e depois + Add Link, Save Links e uma Preview.

alt.en: The Chronicle Staff report, By Chronicle: the filters, then one row per chronicle with its HST, CM, their emails, Prob, Sat and the CM role holder, coloured by match.
alt.pt_BR: O relatório Chronicle Staff, By Chronicle: os filtros e uma linha por crônica com o HST, o CM, os emails deles, Prob, Sat e quem tem o cargo de CM, coloridos pela correspondência.

alt.en: The Conflicts report with Refresh Data and the list of accounts holding more than one staff position.
alt.pt_BR: O relatório Conflicts com Refresh Data e a lista de contas com mais de um cargo de staff.

alt.en: Workspace Links: the Resources, Bylaws and Voting groups, each with its links' labels and addresses, and Save Workspace Links.
alt.pt_BR: Workspace Links: os grupos Resources, Bylaws e Voting, cada um com os rótulos e endereços dos seus links, e Save Workspace Links.

alt.en: The Users list with the ASC Roles and Player ID columns and the Filter by ASC role menu.
alt.pt_BR: A lista Users com as colunas ASC Roles e Player ID e o menu Filter by ASC role.
